definitions.explanation: Made from wood as a material. Used as a の-adjective to describe objects crafted from wood, as opposed to other materials like metal, plastic, or stone.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{木製|もくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧だ。

⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{木製|もくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|いた}んで→傷む：10061_itamu⟧しまう。
examples.english: If old wooden buildings are not maintained regularly, they quickly deteriorate.

notes:
USAGE:
{木製|もくせい} is a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective modifier: {木製|もくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. It specifies wood as the material of construction.

The pattern 〜⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (made of ~) is productive and can be combined with other materials:
- ⟦{金属製|きんぞくせい}→金属製：28457_kinzokusei⟧: made of metal
- ⟦{鉄製|てつせい}→鉄製：25875_tetsusei⟧: made of iron/steel
- ⟦{革製|かわせい}→革製：26255_kawasei⟧: made of leather
- {石製|せきせい}: made of stone

NOTE: This is a homophone of ⟦{木星|もくせい}→木星：13082_mokusei⟧ (Jupiter, the planet).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木製|もくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: wooden furniture
- {木製|もくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧: wooden toy
- {木製|もくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: wooden building
